submission.justification: S1 gives the highest statistical-only expected significance. At 35% efficiency it reaches about 4.06 sigma, against 3.35 for S2 and 2.73 for S3 at 50%. The scan was coarse (35, 50 and 65%) and the differences between points are small. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: none of the project documents report a data/MC comparison in the signal-free validation region, so I could not check the hard 10% mismodelling requirement for any strategy. S1 uses jet substructure variables, which are often harder to model, so the risk is highest for S1. This must be checked before the selection is frozen. If S1 fails, fall back to S2, which uses kinematic variables only, if it passes. S2 is best at about 35-50% efficiency (3.33-3.35 sigma).

requirements.requirement: Data/MC disagreement in the signal-free validation region <=10% for the variables used
requirements.evidence: No validation-region data/MC information in any project document, and the simulation tool covers statistical uncertainty only. The check is still needed, especially for the S1 jet substructure variables.
S1 gives 4.06 sigma at 35%, 3.98 at 50% and 3.84 at 65%. S2 gives 3.28-3.35 and S3 gives 2.73 at 50%. These are statistical-only numbers.
